data.name: Ekanshi
data.gender_notes: Ekanshi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ek means 'one' and Ansh means 'symbol'. Ekanshi symbolizes being the unique representation of a symbol or an embodiment of that symbol. The name Ekanshi carries the meaning “Unique, One and Only” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ekanshi usually hope their child will grow to embody unique, one and only and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ekanshi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unique, One and Only.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ekanshi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
